searchText: buildoor doesn't have any logic for reorgs right now. it builds a payload for whatever payload_attributes the client sent last before the build starts. I'm working on adding reorg support and building multiple payloads too, but it's getting a bit of a mess as all clients have different emission strategies for payload_attributes, some re-emit the event on reorgs, some dont, some are missing gloas fields, etc etc 😅 > it builds a payload for whatever payload_attributes the client sent last before the build starts. yeah was expecting that > but it's getting a bit of a mess as all clients have different emission strategies hmm I think even lodestar probably doesn't do this ideally > some are missing gloas fields, etc etc ah damn, but we didn't even add fields, did we? or you mean literally from the `payload_attributes` sub field. that seems worth pinging clients about, this should work at this point at least in lodestar our `payload_attributes` sse event might also not consider reorgs correctly or weak heads, so you likely build on wrong head lol yea, all clients handle it slightly differently 😄 so for lodestar - we should re-emit, we are not even preparing local payloads correctly, I am aware of that, needs fixing, we need to reorg if ptc votes empty >50% - so omitting parent block number is the spec now, that seems fine, hope buildoor didn't need it - hmm and for normal proposer boost re-org, I think we should just emit for parent of weak head, and maybe re-emit at start of slot if view changes, not sure > so omitting parent block number is the spec now, that seems fine, hope buildoor didn't need it yea, that was flagged as negative point for teku only, which still has it. other clients do not emit the parent block number as intended ideally buildoor should be able to submit multiple bids per slot via single builder entitty yeaa, hmm, I was thinking about depositing multiple keys as the single bid is a currently live limitation. I agree having the ability to send multiple bids should be included. We can still limit the number of bids per builder on p2p by the 4 valid construction categories: parent_full, parent_empty, grandparent_full, grandparent_empty. basically only accept and forward one per category current spec should only allow a single bid per builder per slot you have to predict what the proposer is gonna build on which is impossible almost because clients behave differently and some do not do proposer boost reorgs eg yea, that's what I meant by currently live limitation 😄 The multi bid thingy was more a would be nice to have. I think without, there's no other way than depositing multiple keys to cover all posibilites https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5497 we want that on next devnet

excerpts.author: pk910
excerpts.content:
buildoor doesn't have any logic for reorgs right now.
it builds a payload for whatever payload_attributes the client sent last before the build starts.
I'm working on adding reorg support and building multiple payloads too,  but it's getting a bit of a mess as all clients have different emission strategies for payload_attributes, some re-emit the event on reorgs, some dont,  some are missing gloas fields, etc etc 😅

excerpts.author: nflaig
excerpts.content:
> it builds a payload for whatever payload_attributes the client sent last before the build starts.
yeah was expecting that

> but it's getting a bit of a mess as all clients have different emission strategies
hmm I think even lodestar probably doesn't do this ideally

> some are missing gloas fields, etc etc
ah damn, but we didn't even add fields, did we? or you mean literally from the `payload_attributes` sub field. that seems worth pinging clients about, this should work at this point

excerpts.author: nflaig
excerpts.content: at least in lodestar our `payload_attributes` sse event might also not consider reorgs correctly or weak heads, so you likely build on wrong head lol

excerpts.author: pk910
excerpts.content: yea, all clients handle it slightly differently 😄

excerpts.author: nflaig
excerpts.content:
so for lodestar
- we should re-emit, we are not even preparing local payloads correctly, I am aware of that, needs fixing, we need to reorg if ptc votes empty >50%
- so omitting parent block number is the spec now, that seems fine, hope buildoor didn't need it
- hmm and for normal proposer boost re-org, I think we should just emit for parent of weak head, and maybe re-emit at start of slot if view changes, not sure

excerpts.author: pk910
excerpts.content:
> so omitting parent block number is the spec now, that seems fine, hope buildoor didn't need it
yea,  that was flagged as negative point for teku only, which still has it.  other clients do not emit the parent block number as intended

excerpts.author: nflaig
excerpts.content: ideally buildoor should be able to submit multiple bids per slot via single builder entitty

excerpts.author: pk910
excerpts.content:
yeaa, hmm, I was thinking about depositing multiple keys as the single bid is a currently live limitation.
I agree having the ability to send multiple bids should be included.  We can still limit the number of bids per builder on p2p by the 4 valid construction categories:  parent_full, parent_empty, grandparent_full, grandparent_empty.   basically only accept and forward one per category
